rights_and_provenance_summary.notes: All 27 sprites in v6.0 are unified to match the approved revised cottage_lounge_sofa.png (Asset #2): 3 approved living-room design anchors (cottage_lounge_sofa, low_oak_coffee_table, braided_oval_rug) + 1 living_room_backdrop, 1 user-retained original pinboard design (wall_pinboard_trio with editable SVG source), and 23 sprites redrawn/refined with Antigravity's image-generator referencing both cottage_lounge_sofa.png and each original design, then alpha-extracted, edge-decontaminated, and normalized to 512x512 transparent RGBA PNG in Python.
